title: media.mask_faces payload
description: Payload of a media.mask_faces task (ADR 0036). Both paths are relative to the work directory the Go worker and the masker share (CIPHERFRAME_WORK_DIR). The masker also rejects symlinks that leave the work directory.

input.description: Source video, relative to the work directory. No leading slash, no '..' segment, no backslash.

output.description: Where the masked video is written (MP4, H.264, source audio copied), relative to the work directory. Same rules as input.
